IN THE REPOSITORY: no recorded dataset of reform events of measures. A search of file names for reform, goodhart, metric, indicator, ranking and rating found only Lean logs, physics metrics and one superseded study, _process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/REFORM-EVIDENCE-INTEGRATION.md. I read its first 30 lines: it is a Lean model of a reform changing its own evidence route (8 Oct 2026), not data. Goodhart appears in about 30 live files under _process/research. I read none of them in full; ALIGNMENT.md line 232 cites Manheim and Garrabrant 2018 and Campbell 1979 as informal statements, not datasets. Two narrated cases already in the repository: (a) the imperial examination and the eight-legged essay (科举 → 八股), at theories/meta-attractor/README.md lines 103, 466 and 1027, and 07 §6 ('The imperial examination is this case', a reading); (b) nothing else coded. Precedent for the procedure, a field test on a public archive designed and frozen before any series is read with the run waiting for Ren's yes: experiments/state-named-in-advance (UE31) and experiments/state-against-embedding (UE32), named in experiments/README.md. I did not open those designs.

CANDIDATE PUBLIC RECORDS. These come from my own knowledge, not checked here. Each needs a download, which waits for Ren. Coding them with language models is a model call, which also waits for Ren.
1. LIBOR and other panel-submitted benchmark rates (EURIBOR, TIBOR). The rate is read from the submissions of the banks it serves, so the rule is set by those it concerns. Refutation dated about 2008 (press) and 2012 (regulators' findings); kept until the FCA's 2017 announcement and the 2021–23 cessation. The records are regulator orders and the Wheatley Review (2012). The likely code is 'dropped through an outside reader', which is a case T7 allows. Its value is as a positive control for the coding.
2. University rankings. In US News the peer-assessment component is read from surveys of the deans and presidents of the ranked schools, so the reading is formed by those it ranks. Refutations: Columbia's misreporting (2022). Reform events: the law and medical school withdrawals (2022–23), US News' yearly methodology changes and the withdrawals from THE and QS (several Indian IITs about 2020; Renmin, Nanjing and Lanzhou about 2022; Utrecht 2023). Records: published methodologies and withdrawal statements. The IREG inventory could give a frame fixed by pre-refutation features.
3. Journal Impact Factor in hiring and evaluation. Committees whose members were selected partly by JIF read JIF. Refutation literature from Seglen 1997 on. Reform events: DORA (2012) signatories, Utrecht's 2021 policy, CoARA (2022) signatories. Records: the public DORA and CoARA signatory lists with dates. The difficulty is coding whether a signatory actually stopped reading JIF; signature is not dropping.
4. China's GDP targets in cadre evaluation. Officials promoted on GDP set the next targets. Refutation: data-falsification findings, e.g. Liaoning's 2017 admission. Reform: the 2013 Organization Department notice de-emphasising GDP, and provinces dropping numerical targets (2020). Records: provincial government work reports, and the target dataset of Li, Liu, Weng and Zhou, Economic Journal 2019 (unverified). The 2013 notice is an outside reader (the centre), so a careful code of who forms the rule is needed.
5. Police-recorded crime. The UK Statistics Authority withdrew the National Statistics designation in January 2014, after the PASC inquiry; CompStat is a US counterpart. Records: UKSA assessment reports and HMIC's 2014 crime-data integrity report.
6. Test-score accountability. Refutations include the Atlanta cheating finding (2011). Reform: NCLB to ESSA (2015), a legislature as outside reader. The NHS four-hour A&E target and its 2019 clinically led review (Bevan and Hood 2006 on gaming).
7. Credit ratings. The issuer-pays model was refuted by the 2008 structured-finance failures. Reforms: Dodd-Frank §939A, removing statutory reliance on ratings, and the SEC's annual NRSRO reports.
8. The 科举 eight-legged essay. Abolished in 1898 under the Hundred Days' Reform, restored after the coup the same year, abolished again in 1901, and the examinations ended in 1905. This is a candidate for the third forbidden case, a reform of the reading alone not outlasting the next reading. The repository's 科举 text is a reading, not a coding.
9. Goodhart compendia: Muller's The Tyranny of Metrics (2018), Bevan and Hood (2006), Campbell (1979), and Manheim and Garrabrant (2018), which is a taxonomy. These are selected for notoriety, which conditions on the outcome, so they are unsuitable as a sample frame. They could serve only as a source of candidate measures, to be screened by pre-refutation features.

GENERAL DIFFICULTIES. Almost every documented refutation reaches the public through an outsider, a journalist or a regulator. The design must therefore separate evidence published by an outsider from a reader outside the share who gains a place where the rule is formed or used. Otherwise every drop codes as 'new reader' and T7 cannot fail. The drift clause also needs the selectors' number and the share's distance from the critical mass, read on the case with the drawn model's premises; no candidate record gives these directly.
design_constraints: The measure's premise, documented before the refutation: the measure's rule (who is ranked up) and its reading (how it is read) are formed by those it ranks. Name the documentary sources that establish this, e.g. a peer-survey weight, a panel of submitters, or cadres who set targets. Fix it from records dated before the refutation event. This is the Refuted-by's 'documented in advance as set by those it ranks'.

The sample frame, fixed by features present before refutation: a register or inventory listed as of a date, e.g. every panel-submitted benchmark in force in 2008, every ranking in an inventory as of 2010, every provincial target series 2000–2012. Never a frame built from Goodhart anecdotes or notorious scandals, which conditions on the outcome. List the frame and freeze it before any case's later history is read.

The refutation event: a dated, public finding that the measure fails to track what it claims, of a fixed kind (an official audit, a court or regulator finding, a misreporting admission, a statistic's designation withdrawn, or a replicated study). Fix a minimum standard and record the date as the start of the window.

Kept, dropped and reformed are separate codes, with thresholds: dropped (the selectors stop using it as the rule: abolition, withdrawal, or a weight cut below a fixed fraction); reformed in its reading alone (a methodology change with the same readers); kept. Decide in advance whether a partial cut counts as a drop.

Who forms the rule versus who publishes evidence. A 'reader outside the ranked share' means an actor who gains a place from which the rule is formed or used: vote, legal authority, funding, purchasing, or replacing the rule's users. A journalist or scholar publishing the refutation is evidence, not a new reader. Without this the forbidden case can never be coded. Fix it in the codebook with worked examples written before the cases are read.

The other two exits, also coded in advance: 'a change in what the ranking reads' (new components or new data) and 'a loss entering their share' (a cost borne by the selectors themselves, e.g. fines, lost revenue, or the selectors' own members harmed), each with its documentary test.

The window and the reading step. The window runs a fixed number of years after the refutation, e.g. 10. A reading step is the measure's own revision cycle (annual methodology review, rating committee, target-setting cycle, examination-regulation revision). The third case is checked at the next reading step after a reform of the reading.

The drift clause, read on the case: the Refuted-by requires 'the selectors many enough and the share far enough above the critical mass that, by the drawn model's bound read on the case, drift alone would rarely leave it'. Fix in advance how the selectors are counted, how their share and the critical mass are estimated, and the bound below which drift counts as rare. Alternatively state up front that cases whose drift bound cannot be read are excluded, and report how many were excluded. Do not decide eligibility after outcomes are seen.

The verdict rule and its threshold: how many eligible cases coded 'dropped by its selectors with no outside reader, no change in what is read, and no loss entering their share' refute T7. One case, by the Refuted-by's singular wording, or a count above what the drift bound allows, by the second Forbids clause. Fix it together with the eligible N, a stopping rule (the frame is the sample, with no additions), and a separate pass condition, so that the test can fail.
Coding blind to outcome where possible: coders see the documents for each code separately (premise, refutation, readers, outcome), and the hypothesis is not stated in their prompt.

Who decides the verdict, as in RF's freezes (FREEZE-1 line 40: 'Two families that neither wrote nor read the theory decide; the theory's own is reported apart'): coders of at least two model families, or human coders, that neither wrote nor read the theory, with versions pinned. The theory's own family is reported apart and decides nothing alone. Agreement between coders is computed, and a rule fixes disagreements in advance.

The fourth case, separately if attempted: per T7C, 'a refuter for the fourth case is open design work'. A field version needs the loss coded as read only by those the metric disfavours, the date at which they become no more than its carriers among its readers, and a drop after that with nothing else changed. Keep it apart from the Refuted-by's case and do not narrow it after the cases are read (T7C's lesson).

Positive controls: include in the frame cases expected to be coded 'outside reader' (e.g. LIBOR's 2017 regulator decision) to check that the codebook can find the allowed exits. Check the codebook on worked examples before freezing.

Ren's part: any download of the records and any model call for the coding wait for his yes, as does machine time or money. Freezing the design, the frame list, the codebook and the verdict rule does not wait.

The RF freezes (experiments/formations-that-read/FREEZE-1.md to FREEZE-11.md) are the procedural model for who decides: FREEZE-1 line 40 and FREEZE-8 line 32 pin two non-Anthropic families. They test other laws, not T7.
UE31 and UE32 (experiments/state-named-in-advance, experiments/state-against-embedding) are precedents for field tests on public archives, frozen before the series was read. Both were for T2, not T7.
forbids:
T7's Forbids, verbatim (02-MAP.md line 434): "*Forbids*: such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone; such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on the case; a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading; a metric whose loss is read only by those it disfavours, dropped once the selection has left them no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift alone would allow." Its Refuted-by, verbatim: "a metric whose rule and reading were documented in advance as set by those it ranks, dropped by those selectors while a coding fixed in advance finds no new reader outside the ranked share, no change in what the ranking reads and no loss entering their share, the selectors many enough and the share far enough above the critical mass that, by the drawn model's bound read on the case, drift alone would rarely leave it."

A reform event, in T7's terms, is a metric dropped, or its reading changed, by its selectors. T7 allows a drop only "through a change in what the loop reads (a reader outside the share, a loss entering it, a new reading), not on evidence alone", with "drift aside".

What would meet the forbidden case in the field:
- A recorded measure whose rule and reading are documented, before its refutation, as set by those it ranks.
- A documented refutation.
- The measure dropped by those same selectors within the window.
- A coding frozen in advance that finds no outside reader gaining a place where the rule is formed or used, no change in what the measure reads, and no loss entering the selectors' share.
- The selectors many and their share far above the critical mass, by the drawn model's bound read on the case.

The third case is met by a methodology or reading reform, with the same readers, that persists past the next revision cycle. The fourth case is met by a measure dropped once those its loss is read by are no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift allows. Per T7C, the Refuted-by names no test of the fourth case.

Two limits from the home: "Evidence, refutation and institutions are unformalized, and the unread coordinate is a loss by reading", and "That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured." The coding therefore carries the whole bridge.

LA2 covered a trained judge (Claude Haiku) in a self-rewarding loop, not recorded human institutions. A field test means recorded institutions whose metrics (rankings, impact factors, benchmark rates, GDP targets, police statistics, credit ratings, examination forms) were refuted, then kept or reformed.

home.quote: **Thesis T7.** *A measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation*: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is kept by its selectors however large a loss it does not read grows, and, drift aside, is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads (a reader outside the share, a loss entering it, a new reading), not on evidence alone. *In the model* only invariance under what the loop does not read, and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate, are proved, both without noise; a reading of the loss is one sufficient way out, not shown the only one. ... So the thesis is about courses where drift alone rarely leaves the lock, not every drop. ... Evidence, refutation and institutions are unformalized, and the unread coordinate is a loss by reading. That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured. *Forbids*: [verbatim in the forbids field] ... *Refuted by*: [verbatim in the forbids field] ... *Evidence*: no frozen field test of reform events, which needs a coding of reform events fixed before the cases are read; one frozen test in one trained system, LA2, below.

*Frozen test* (frozen 25 October 2026, run 25 and 26 October): LA2, a lock in a self-rewarding loop, frozen at `36c8b79cb` ... So the fourth case, as worded before its clause on drift (without the note the judge chose lists in 60 of 60), occurred in this system, at both readings, of a judge formed from what it selected, which meets T7's premise: LA2 counts against that case as a claim about trained judges, and is kept as that counterexample. ... T7's other forbidden cases are not touched, and its *Refuted by* names no test of this case. ... It is not the field test of reform events above, which stays open.

So a lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise, or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing, its exits bounded across the distance from its critical mass; a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.
- A field test of T1 with a need measured in advance; T2 on grazed grassland or harvested forests; a frozen field test of T7's reform events.

| T7. A measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation | [02](02-MAP.md#t7) | in the model only invariance under what the loop does not read, and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate, proved, both without noise; ... that actual metrics are so formed conjectured | such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone; such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises read on the case; a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading; and one more in [02](02-MAP.md#t7) | LA2, a lock in a self-rewarding loop in one trained system: ...

LA2 ([experiment](../../../experiments/self-rewarding-lock/README.md), [T7](02-MAP.md#t7)) asks who reads. A judge formed from the loop's own selections locked where nothing read the loss, and one note of the loss among nine readers turned it.

The imperial examination is this case, as read in [the meta-attractor line](../../meta-attractor/README.md): designed to dilute hereditary capture, it later became a proxy trap of its own. It rests on the capture laws, not on the law of shaping.
T7's *Refuted by* is narrower: it asks for no change in what is read. So it names no test of this case, and a refuter for the fourth case is open design work.

Each dynamic's `forbids` field is checked for reach. Where a forbidden case could be met but no test is designed, a design is drafted and frozen. Freezing is not Ren's; any run with model calls or downloads is. ... - **T7's field test** of reform events. Its Forbids names one, and 02 Open asks for it. ... Each design names who decides its verdict, a family that neither wrote nor read the theory, as RF's freezes do.

- [this dossier, AI] Goodhart's and Campbell's laws (Manheim and Garrabrant 2018; Campbell 1979) describe informally a measure that keeps its standing after it stops measuring. T7 states that as a conjecture about a lock. **Questions.** 1. Is there a measured case of a metric kept after its refutation in which the keepers were selected by the metric? What would count as evidence?

lean.name: Becoming.ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss
lean.statement: A locked loop outlives its loss: from a locked configuration, with the loss growing by at least one a step and read by neither the selection nor the reading, the loss at step t is at least b + t, the course is locked, and share and rule are not below where they started.
lean.premises: Raises, ReadsShare (rule read monotonically from the share alone), favouring kept upward, Accrues, Locked start; no noise. Pure core, empty axiom report (closed-capture record, receipt 20261025T045617.350224Z).

lean.name: Becoming.ClosedCapture.turned_by_loss
lean.statement: Where the rule read favours at no configuration whose loss is at least N, at the step after every reading step past N the rule in force does not favour: one sufficient way out.
lean.premises: Accrues; a rule read that reads the loss.

lean.name: Becoming.ClosedCapture.reading_absorbed
lean.statement: A change of the reading, either way, with the rule still favouring, is absorbed at the next reading step: rule and reading are at least where they were and the course is locked again. This is the law under the third Forbids clause.
lean.premises: Raises, favouring kept upward, the read monotone, the reading formed from the share (ReadsShare on mind), locked before.

lean.name: Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_reads_iff and Thinned.kept_iff / turned_iff
lean.statement: A pool of readers counted by kind reads the share exactly where v ≤ u. Where only the others read the loss late, mirrored, the counts at that step decide for good whether the lock is kept or turned. This is the law under the fourth case.
lean.premises: Readers drawn from the selected, counted by kind; the readers' premise lo ≤ hi; Accrues.

lean.name: Becoming.DrawnReplacement.lost_above
lean.statement: Drawn one member at a time, above the critical mass, losing every shaper from s + n weighs at most t times down^n times the whole weight, over the shapers' weights: the drift bound across the distance that the second Forbids clause and the Refuted-by read on the case.
lean.premises: One member drawn at a time among M + 1, constant readings and cost, lo ≤ hi, 0 < a.

open_questions: Separating evidence from a new reader. Almost every refutation is published by an outsider. Does T7's 'a reader outside the share' mean only an actor gaining a place where the rule is formed or used? 02 does not say. If not, the first forbidden case cannot be coded. The design must decide this, and 02's wording may need a line fixing it, which would be a home change, not this test's.

How a drop is counted. Is a reduced weight (e.g. a ranking cutting its peer-survey weight) a drop, a reform of the reading, or kept? T7 says 'dropped' and 'a reform of the reading alone', and gives no threshold.

Whether the drift clause can be read on any field case. Counting the selectors, their share and the critical mass needs the drawn model's premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on an institution. If no case can be read, the Refuted-by's case is out of reach in the field, and the design must say so rather than exclude cases after reading them.

Whether a single coded case refutes T7, as the Refuted-by's singular wording suggests, or a count above what the drift bound allows, as the second Forbids clause suggests. These differ, and the design must fix one.

Whether to attempt the fourth case in the field too, since T7C names a refuter for it as open design work. That would also need the date at which the disfavoured readers become no more than the carriers among the readers.

Who codes: human coders who have not read the theory, or two non-Anthropic model families as in RF's freezes. Model coding is a model call and waits for Ren; so does downloading the records. Freezing the frame, the codebook and the verdict rule does not.

The 科举 case is narrated in the repository only as a reading (meta-attractor README, 07 §6). Whether it enters the frame as a candidate for the third case must be decided before its history is coded, or it is excluded as already read.

The atlas readers' report (dynamics-map-knowing.md line 220) cites 02 lines 434–436 and 476 and the old 'Evidence: none frozen'. 02 now says 'no frozen field test of reform events' at line 434, and the Open line is at 478. The report is stale, not wrong about the gap.
